label: Vascular access
الوصول الوعائي
description: A dual-lumen central venous catheter draws blood out through the 'access' (red/arterial) lumen and returns it through the 'return' (blue/venous) lumen. Lumen patency and position are checked before and during therapy.
قسطرة وريدية مركزية مزدوجة التجويف تسحب الدم عبر تجويف 'الوصول' (الشرياني/الأحمر) وتعيده عبر تجويف 'العودة' (الوريدي/الأزرق). يتم التحقق من سلامة التجويفين وموضعهما قبل العلاج وأثناءه.

label: Blood pump
مضخة الدم
description: A roller pump draws blood from the access lumen at a set rate (mL/min) and drives it through the circuit. Pump speed is a prescribed, machine-set parameter - not something a nurse adjusts independently of the prescription and local protocol.
مضخة دوارة تسحب الدم من تجويف الوصول بمعدل محدد (مل/دقيقة) وتدفعه عبر الدائرة. سرعة المضخة معلمة موصوفة يحددها الجهاز - وليست شيئاً تعدّله الممرضة بمعزل عن الوصفة والبروتوكول المحلي.

label: Hemofilter
الفلتر الدموي
description: The hemofilter is a semi-permeable membrane where solutes and fluid cross from blood into the effluent (filtration), and/or dialysate exchanges solutes across the membrane (dialysis). Clotting inside the filter reduces its surface area and raises the pressure drop across it (transmembrane pressure).

الفلتر الدموي غشاء شبه نفوذ تعبر عبره المذابات والسوائل من الدم إلى الراشح (الترشيح)، و/أو يتبادل سائل الديلزة المذابات عبر الغشاء (الديلزة). يقلل التخثر داخل الفلتر من مساحة سطحه ويرفع فرق الضغط عبره (ضغط عبر الغشاء).

label: Dialysate
سائل الديلزة
description: A balanced electrolyte solution run counter-current to blood flow around the filter membrane, used in dialysis-based CRRT modes (CVVHD/CVVHDF) to clear solutes by diffusion. Bag changes and connections are checked for correct fluid, correct line, and air-free connection.

محلول إلكتروليت متوازن يُمرَّر بعكس اتجاه تدفق الدم حول غشاء الفلتر، يُستخدم في أنماط العلاج بالديلزة (CVVHD/CVVHDF) لتصفية المذابات بالانتشار. يتم التحقق عند تغيير الأكياس من صحة السائل والخط والتوصيل الخالي من الهواء.

label: Replacement fluid
سائل الاستبدال
description: A balanced electrolyte solution infused pre-filter or post-filter to replace fluid removed by convection in hemofiltration-based modes (CVVH/CVVHDF). Pre- vs post-filter delivery affects filter clotting risk and clearance, and is a prescribed setting.
محلول إلكتروليت متوازن يُحقن قبل الفلتر أو بعده لتعويض السائل المُزال بالحمل في أنماط الترشيح الدموي (CVVH/CVVHDF). يؤثر التوصيل قبل أو بعد الفلتر على خطر تخثر الفلتر والتصفية، وهو إعداد موصوف.

label: Effluent / drain
الراشح / التصريف
description: The combined spent dialysate, filtered fluid and ultrafiltrate removed from the patient, collected in the effluent bag. Its weight is tracked by the machine to calculate net fluid removal from the patient - an unexpectedly empty or overflowing bag is always worth investigating.

مزيج سائل الديلزة المستهلك والسائل المُرشَّح والراشح الفائق المُزال من المريض، يُجمع في كيس الراشح. يتتبع الجهاز وزنه لحساب صافي السائل المُزال من المريض - يستحق الكيس الفارغ بشكل غير متوقع أو الفائض الفحص دائماً.

label: Return line
خط العودة
description: Filtered/dialyzed blood travels back to the patient through the return (venous) lumen. An air detector and venous pressure sensor sit on this line as the last safety checks before blood re-enters the patient.
يعود الدم المُرشَّح/المُعالَج بالديلزة إلى المريض عبر تجويف العودة (الوريدي). يوجد كاشف هواء وحساس ضغط وريدي على هذا الخط كآخر فحوصات السلامة قبل عودة الدم إلى المريض.
alarms: Air detected in the return line

label: Pressure monitoring
مراقبة الضغوط
description: The machine continuously monitors access, filter, return (venous) and effluent pressures. Trends in these pressures - not any single reading - are what reveal clotting, kinking, recirculation or a line problem early, before the circuit fails outright.

يراقب الجهاز باستمرار ضغوط الوصول والفلتر والعودة (الوريدي) والراشح. اتجاهات هذه الضغوط - وليس أي قراءة منفردة - هي ما يكشف التخثر أو الانثناء أو إعادة التدوير أو مشكلة الخط مبكراً، قبل فشل الدائرة تماماً.

title: High access (pre-filter) pressure
ضغط الوصول (قبل الفلتر) المرتفع
alarms.vignette: The machine alarms for high access pressure. The patient's femoral access line is at the groin, and the patient has just been repositioned.

question.prompt: What is the most appropriate first nursing action?
options: Assess the patient, then check the access line and clamps for kinking or a position-related obstruction
Immediately increase the blood pump speed to clear the alarm
Disconnect and discard the circuit without further assessment
Silence the alarm and continue, since access pressure alarms are usually false
question.explanation: An access alarm after repositioning can occur when a line kinks or the catheter tip contacts the vessel wall. Assess the patient first and inspect the external circuit and clamps. Follow the device-specific pathway if the alarm persists.

title: Rising filter pressure over several hours
ارتفاع ضغط الفلتر تدريجياً خلال ساعات
alarms.vignette: Over several hours, the transmembrane pressure has been trending upward and the filter looks darker than usual through the viewing window.

question.prompt: What does this trend most likely indicate, and what is the nursing priority?
options: Likely filter clotting - notify the team, since the filter may need replacing before it fails and the circuit clots off completely
A normal, expected finding that needs no action for the remainder of the prescribed run
Definite patient coagulopathy requiring immediate reversal of anticoagulation
A sign the replacement fluid rate is set too high and should be reduced immediately by the nurse
question.explanation: A rising transmembrane pressure with a darkening filter is the classic early pattern of filter clotting - recognising this trend and escalating supports proactive filter change before the circuit clots off, interrupting therapy and losing the patient's blood volume in the circuit.

title: Air-in-line alarm on the return line
إنذار وجود هواء في خط العودة
alarms.vignette: The air detector on the return line alarms and the machine has automatically clamped the return line.

question.prompt: What is the appropriate nursing response?
options: Do not bypass or override the air detector; assess the circuit for the air source and involve the team before resuming
Manually override the clamp immediately so therapy is not interrupted
Flush the return line with air to clear the sensor
Assume the sensor is faulty and continue without further checks
question.explanation: An air detector clamping the return line is a critical safety feature preventing air embolism - it must never be bypassed; the priority is finding and correcting the source of air (a loose connection, an empty bag feeding the line) before therapy resumes.

title: Low access pressure with intermittent flow interruption
ضغط وصول منخفض مع انقطاع متقطع للتدفق
alarms.vignette: The access pressure alarm shows an unusually low (negative) reading and blood flow intermittently stops, especially when the patient moves.

question.prompt: What does this suggest, and what should the nurse do first?
options: A suction event from the access lumen pulling against the vessel wall - reassess catheter position and the patient's position
The blood pump is set too slow and should be increased by the nurse without further assessment
This is always a sign of filter clotting and the filter should be changed
This is a normal variant that never needs reassessment
question.explanation: A very low (strongly negative) access pressure with position-dependent flow interruption is characteristic of catheter-tip suction against the vessel wall - reassessing catheter and patient position is the appropriate first step, rather than adjusting pump speed or assuming filter failure.
